title: achillea ligustica
intro: Achillea ligustica, commonly known as Yarrow, is a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region, belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating wounds, skin conditions, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Yarrow include reducing fever, relieving menstrual cramps, and aiding in the treatment of colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of Yarrow include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
